name: drop push up
description: A depth-style push-up between two raised supports, dropping the hands to the floor and rebounding for chest power.
instructions: Place two stable raised supports shoulder-width apart and set one hand on each support; step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest between the supports, then press up explosively and move your hands to the floor between them.
Land with soft elbows and absorb the drop in a push-up position.
Press back up, reset your hands on the supports and repeat with controlled landings.
